# Design point P018

## Description

The client offers a consolidated maintenance command that performs configuration, fetching, graph updates, loose-object cleanup, and pack cleanup as one operation. Offline development is supported, but the fetching portion may require connectivity to the centralized host or be deferred while disconnected.
